Trigger.Name: WHEN-LIST-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_temp varchar2(5);
 v_string varchar2(300);
BEGIN

 v_temp:='HOLDS';
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='A' then /* All holds for this donor */
 
 v_string:='donor_id=:parameter.p_donor_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='D' then /* Active donation holds */
 
 v_string:='donor_id=:parameter.p_donor_id and release_date is null and transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_select_donor='H' then /* All donation holds */

 v_string:='donor_id=:parameter.p_donor_id and transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id and inter_type = '||''''||v_temp||'''';
 
 end if;

 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',default_where,v_string); 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_O (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS

 END IF;
END;
